--2 Legal impurity
or contamination; defilement
caused either by child-birth (called
जननाशौच) or by the death of some
relation (called मृताशौच); it lasts for
10 days; during the मृताशौच a person
defiled by it is not to touch any body
else, or to eat with others in the
same row or to do any sacred action;
अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बांधवैः सह

.
--Comp.
--अंतः end of
defilement.
--संकरः blending or
coming together of two or more
defilements.

] Impurity, see अशौचं; दशाहं
शावमाशौचं ब्राह्मणस्य विधीयते

असौनामन् a. Ved. Having such
and such a name.

असौम्य a. Not lovely, ugly,
disagreeable; ˚स्वर a. having a bad or
croaking voice.

असौष्ठव a.
1 Devoid of beauty
or loveliness, not in good trim;
शरीरमसौष्ठवं

.
--2 Ugly,
deformed.
--वं
1 Worthlessness, absence
of merit.
--2 Deformity, ugliness.
